dateFrom.description: Only return tweets posted on or after this date. Leave empty for no lower bound.
dateFrom.title: Start date

dateTo.description: Only return tweets posted on or before this date. Leave empty for no upper bound.
dateTo.title: End date

endDate.description: Deprecated — use 'End date' instead. Kept so existing saved inputs keep working. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
endDate.title: End date (legacy)

excludeReplies.description: Skip replies and keep only top-level posts.
excludeReplies.title: Exclude replies

excludeRetweets.description: Skip retweets/reposts and keep only original posts.
excludeRetweets.title: Exclude retweets (reposts)

keywords.description: Words, phrases, hashtags or full X search queries to monitor. Each keyword is searched separately, and every result row tells you which keyword found it (searchTerm).
keywords.title: Search keywords

language.description: Only return tweets written in this language. Leave the default to search all languages.
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Alias of Maximum tweets per keyword. The actor accepts either name.
maxItems.title: Maximum tweets per keyword (alias)

maxTweets.description: Stop after this many tweets for each keyword.
maxTweets.title: Maximum tweets per keyword

minimumLikes.description: Only return tweets with at least this many likes. Leave empty for no minimum.
minimumLikes.title: Minimum likes

minimumReplies.description: Only return tweets with at least this many replies. Leave empty for no minimum.
minimumReplies.title: Minimum replies

minimumRetweets.description: Only return tweets with at least this many retweets. Leave empty for no minimum.
minimumRetweets.title: Minimum retweets

onlyImages.description: Only return tweets that contain at least one image.
onlyImages.title: Tweets with images only

onlyVerifiedUsers.description: Only return tweets from verified (blue check) accounts.
onlyVerifiedUsers.title: Verified accounts only

onlyVideos.description: Only return tweets that contain at least one video or GIF.
onlyVideos.title: Tweets with videos only

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if you run large jobs or see frequent IP-based rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchType.description: Top returns the most relevant and popular tweets. Latest returns the newest tweets first — best for real-time monitoring.
searchType.title: Result order

sort.description: Alias of Result order. The actor accepts either name.
sort.title: Result order (alias)

startDate.description: Deprecated — use 'Start date' instead. Kept so existing saved inputs keep working. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
startDate.sectionDescription: Deprecated aliases kept for backwards compatibility. Prefer the fields above.
startDate.title: Start date (legacy)
